name: io.github.ipvolt/account
title: ipvolt account
description: Mobile proxies at ipvolt: prices and stock, buy with x402 (USDC), rent and rotate with an API key.

tools.name: list_stock
tools.description: Read-only, free, no credential needed. List the dedicated mobile proxy rentals ipvolt sells now: country, carrier, length (1 or 30 days), price in US cents and whether each is in stock. It never shows stock counts. While per-GB traffic is on sale it also lists the prepaid GB packs with their prices and the countries each shared pool has now. Filter by country, carrier or length. Use it before rent_proxy.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US.

carrier.description: Carrier name as list_stock shows it, for example Verizon.

includeSoldOut.description: Also list rentals that are sold out now. Default false.

tools.name: how_to_buy
tools.description: Read-only, free, no credential needed. Explains how to get a credential for the account tools of this server, how the prepaid balance is added, how buy_proxy rents a proxy without an account for an x402 payment, the current Terms version, and where the Terms and the Acceptable Use Policy are. This tool itself takes no payment and issues no credential.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read-only, free. Show the prepaid ipvolt balance (available and held) of the credential's account and, for an API key, its access level, daily spending limit, what it spent today and what it can still spend today; for an agent token, its permissions and spending cap.

tools.name: list_rentals
tools.description: Read-only, free. List the account's active proxy rentals with their connection details (host, ports, username, password), end time, online state, current IP and whether each can rotate or extend. The connection details are secrets: keep them in the user's own configuration.

tools.name: get_rental
tools.description: Read-only, free. Show one of the account's active rentals with its connection details (host, ports, username, password), end time, online state, current IP and whether it can rotate or extend. The connection details are secrets: keep them in the user's own configuration.

tools.name: rent_proxy
tools.description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Rent dedicated mobile proxy devices for 1 or 30 days. Two steps: (1) call without confirm: this only looks up the current price and answers the exact charge and a requestId; nothing is charged. (2) Only after the user approved that charge, call again with confirm: true and that requestId. If the price rose meanwhile the API refuses instead of charging more, and repeating a confirmed requestId returns the same order without charging again. The first call needs country, carrier and days (and optional quantity). Needs a read-write API key, an agent token that may buy, or the order's invoice ID.

country.description: Two-letter country code from list_stock. Required for the preview.

carrier.description: Carrier name from list_stock. Required for the preview.

days.description: Rental length, 1 or 30 days. Required for the preview.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview the charge. Set true, with the preview requestId, only after the user approved that charge.

requestId.description: The requestId the preview returned, copied exactly. Use it only with confirm: true.

tools.name: extend_rental
tools.description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Extend one of the account's active rentals by 1 or 30 days. Two steps: (1) call without confirm: this only looks up the current price and answers the exact charge and a requestId; nothing is charged. (2) Only after the user approved that charge, call again with confirm: true and that requestId. If the price rose meanwhile the API refuses instead of charging more, and repeating a confirmed requestId returns the same order without charging again. Needs a read-write API key, an agent token that may buy, or the order's invoice ID.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview the charge. Set true, with the preview requestId, only after the user approved that charge.

requestId.description: The requestId the preview returned, copied exactly. Use it only with confirm: true.

tools.name: rotate_ip
tools.description: CHANGES STATE, costs nothing. Ask for a new IP address on one of the account's rentals. Connections open through the device may drop while it changes. Rotating too soon is refused with the number of seconds to wait; the dashboard's limits apply. Needs a read-write API key, an agent token that may buy, or the order's invoice ID.

tools.name: list_traffic
tools.description: Read-only, free. Show the account's per-GB traffic: the traffic key's state, GB bought, used and left, the gateway host and ports, the countries the residential and the shared mobile pool have now, and the prepaid packs with their prices. It shows no secret; get_traffic_connection gives a connection line. Needs an API key or an agent token of an ipvolt account.

tools.name: buy_traffic_pack
tools.description: SPENDS MONEY from the prepaid ipvolt balance of the credential's account. Buy one prepaid pack of GB for residential IPs and for mobile IPs from a shared pool. Two steps: (1) call without confirm: this only looks up the current price and answers the exact charge and a requestId; nothing is charged. (2) Only after the user approved that charge, call again with confirm: true and that requestId. If the price rose meanwhile the API refuses instead of charging more, and repeating a confirmed requestId returns the same order without charging again. The first call needs packId (from list_traffic or list_stock). A pack is bought under the current Terms and Refund Policy, which the dashboard asks the customer to accept at each pack purchase: confirm the pack and its price with the user first. Needs a read-write API key or an agent token that may buy, of an ipvolt account.

packId.description: Pack id from list_traffic or list_stock, for example gb:5. Required for the preview.

confirm.description: Leave out to preview the charge. Set true, with the preview requestId, only after the user approved that charge.

requestId.description: The requestId the preview returned, copied exactly. Use it only with confirm: true.

tools.name: get_traffic_connection
tools.description: Read-only, free. Get one ready connection line for the account's per-GB traffic: host, port, username and the traffic key as password, for the residential or the shared mobile network in one country. The line is a secret: keep it in the user's own configuration. Using it spends the account's GB. Needs an API key or an agent token of an ipvolt account.

network.description: residential, or mobile for the shared mobile pool.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example US.

tools.name: buy_proxy
tools.description: SPENDS REAL MONEY from the caller's own wallet: USDC on Base, paid over x402, $1.00 to $500.00 per purchase. Not refundable on chain. Rents one dedicated mobile proxy for 1 or 30 days with no ipvolt account, API key or order set up first. Three calls. (1) Without a receipt and without a payment: nothing is charged or created; the answer is a quote with the exact price and a receipt. SAVE THE RECEIPT BEFORE PAYING: it is a secret, and the only way to what you pay for. (2) After the user approved that charge, the same call with the argument receipt: the answer is an x402 payment request, or, if this receipt was already paid, what became of the purchase. (3) The same call, receipt included, with the x402 payment in params._meta["x402/payment"]; an x402 client makes this call by itself. One payment per receipt: repeating a call with its receipt never charges twice. If an answer is lost, repeat the call with the receipt or call get_purchase with it; never go back to a call without the receipt once you may have paid. The proxy is rented after ipvolt has confirmed the payment on chain, usually within a few minutes: call get_purchase with the receipt, and never pay again while it is being confirmed. The official x402 clients refuse payments above $1.00 until the wallet's owner raises their limit. At most 6 purchases an hour and 20 a day per network (assistants of one vendor may share a network). acceptTerms accepts the Terms and the Acceptable Use Policy for whoever the purchase is for; the current termsVersion is "2026-11-05".

acceptTerms.description: true: the Terms and the Acceptable Use Policy are accepted for whoever the purchase is for.

termsVersion.description: The Terms version that is accepted, as the description of this tool and how_to_buy name it.

receipt.description: Leave out for a quote. On every call after it: the receipt of your own quote, copied exactly. Required with a payment. A secret.

tools.name: get_purchase
tools.description: Takes no payment. Continues a purchase made with buy_proxy from its receipt, and can be repeated at any time: it says whether the payment is confirmed, rents the proxy that was paid for once ipvolt has confirmed the payment on chain (usually within a few minutes), never above the price that was paid and never twice, and then gives the connection details (host, ports, username, password), which are secrets. The receipt is a secret too. Needs no account and no credential.

receipt.description: The receipt buy_proxy returned, copied exactly. A secret: whoever has it can use the purchase.
